import modal
import io
from pathlib import Path

image = modal.Image.debian_slim(python_version="3.12").pip_install(
    "diffusers==0.33.1",
    "torch==2.7.0",
    "transformers==4.51.3",
    "accelerate==1.6.0",
    "sentencepiece==0.2.0",
    "pillow==11.0.0",
    "imageio==2.37.0",
    "imageio-ffmpeg==0.5.1"
)

app = modal.App("image-to-video", image=image)

MODEL_PATH = Path("/models")
OUTPUTS_PATH = Path("/outputs")
outputs = modal.Volume.from_name("ltx2-outputs", create_if_missing=True)
model_cache = modal.Volume.from_name("ltx2-model-cache", create_if_missing=True)

image = image.env({"HF_HOME": str(MODEL_PATH)})

@app.cls(
    image=image,
    gpu="B200",
    volumes={MODEL_PATH: model_cache, OUTPUTS_PATH: outputs},
    timeout=600,
    scaledown_window=300
)
class Model:
    @modal.enter()
    def load_model(self):
        import torch
        from diffusers import LTX2ImageToVideoPipeline

        self.pipe = LTX2ImageToVideoPipeline.from_pretrained(
            "Lightricks/LTX-2",
            torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16
        )
        self.pipe.to("cuda")
        self.pipe.enable_sequential_cpu_offload()
        model_cache.commit()

    @modal.method()
    def generate_video(self, image_bytes: bytes, prompt: str = "Camera slowly pans across the scene", negative_prompt: str = "worst quality, blurry, jittery, distorted", num_inference_steps: int = 40, guidance_scale: float = 4.0, num_frames: int = 121, width: int = 768, height: int = 512):
        import torch
        from PIL import Image
        from diffusers.pipelines.ltx2.export_utils import encode_video
        import time

        input_image = Image.open(io.BytesIO(image_bytes)).convert("RGB")
        
        frame_rate = 24.0
        
        video_frames, audio = self.pipe(
            image=input_image,
            prompt=prompt,
            negative_prompt=negative_prompt,
            width=width,
            height=height,
            num_frames=num_frames,
            num_inference_steps=num_inference_steps,
            guidance_scale=guidance_scale,
            frame_rate=frame_rate,
            output_type="np",
            return_dict=False
        )
        
        video_frames = (video_frames * 255).round().astype("uint8")
        video_tensor = torch.from_numpy(video_frames)
        
        timestamp = int(time.time())
        filename = f"generated_{timestamp}.mp4"
        output_path = OUTPUTS_PATH / filename
        
        encode_video(
            video_tensor[0],
            fps=frame_rate,
            audio=audio[0].float().cpu() if audio is not None else None,
            audio_sample_rate=self.pipe.vocoder.config.output_sampling_rate if audio is not None else None,
            output_path=str(output_path)
        )
        
        outputs.commit()
        
        with open(output_path, "rb") as f:
            video_bytes = f.read()
        
        return video_bytes

@app.function()
@modal.asgi_app()
def api():
    from fastapi import FastAPI, File, UploadFile, Form
    from fastapi.responses import Response
    
    web_app = FastAPI()
    
    @web_app.post("/generate")
    async def generate_video_endpoint(
        image: UploadFile = File(...),
        prompt: str = Form("Camera slowly pans across the scene"),
        negative_prompt: str = Form("worst quality, blurry, jittery, distorted"),
        num_inference_steps: int = Form(40),
        guidance_scale: float = Form(4.0),
        num_frames: int = Form(121),
        width: int = Form(768),
        height: int = Form(512)
    ):
        image_bytes = await image.read()
        
        model = Model()
        video_data = model.generate_video.remote(
            image_bytes=image_bytes,
            prompt=prompt,
            negative_prompt=negative_prompt,
            num_inference_steps=num_inference_steps,
            guidance_scale=guidance_scale,
            num_frames=num_frames,
            width=width,
            height=height
        )
        
        return Response(content=video_data, media_type="video/mp4")
    
    return web_app
